**Verdict: PASS** for DG5 round 3 on the frozen candidate `sha256:fc93b239…57fd` (2187 files, source `bbd6294`). The candidate ID matched on a complete disposable clone and on the main checkout, at the start and the end of the review.

**My two open findings are verified closed:**
- **F-DG5-142 (Medium):** my round-2 reproduction, re-run unchanged, is now clean on all 12 screens in en and ar, in both locale settings.
  - A wider new probe covered 38 older (DG2–DG4) screens at 390 px, 1366 px and 200 % text: no serious or critical axe issues, and every scrolling table region is focusable and named.
  - Real Tab presses reach every region on the finding's four screens, and the arrow keys scroll it, right-to-left in Arabic too.
  - FE-X1's own spec passes on demo and production data. I accept observation (k), the repeated region name on the two dashboards, as polish.
- **F-DG5-143 (Low):** only the test's locator changed; its assertions are unchanged.
  - The underlying cause still exists (the API's first item is random in 400 of 500 trials), so targeting the row by its id is the right fix.
  - `--repeat-each=10` gave 60/60, then 59/60, then 60/60. The single failure was a Chromium crash in a different test (T14) under memory pressure. T01 passed 20/20 in every run.

**What ran on this candidate:**
- **Static checks:** all passed; the API contract lint reports 846 operations.
- **Unit:** 2340/1711/259 (+2 skipped by design), with a clean run in every Node 22/24 and locale combination.
- **Integration:** 318 files, 3056 passed + 1 skipped, twice; `tests/qa` alone 336/336.
- **Product e2e:** 444/444 with C.UTF-8. With the locale unset, all 444 pass across runs; the failures in between were timeouts under load and passed on re-run.
- **Root and demo e2e:** root acceptance specs 30/30 in three runs; demo specs 12/12 in two runs.
- **REQ-DLV-037:** A06 27, A07 12, A15 34, A16 30. I inspected 26 export samples in PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and CSV, in en and ar.
- **Validators:** register, pipeline and the historical DG1–DG4 checks all pass.

**Disclosures:**
- **Timeouts under load:** every failure in my logs is explained in the record. Most were timeouts while all three reviews ran on 4 CPUs (load average up to 29), and my own parallel runs added to that.
- **2-hour task limit:** my tool's limit stopped two runs part-way (integration run 2 and one root e2e run). Neither had a failure, and both were replaced by complete runs.
- **Probe revisions:** my new probe went through two revisions to remove its own artefacts. All attempts' logs are kept.
- **Demo banner:** my round-1 probe missed the demo banner on one screen of 31, a different screen in three runs. The screenshot at that moment really has no banner; my round-2 note said otherwise, and I correct it here. The cause is the documented fail-safe: no synthetic label until the server confirms the database is synthetic. I accept it as designed.
- **Observations (h)–(k) and the 60 s budget:** I accept D-173's observations (h)–(k) and the orchestrator's 60 s test budget, with reasons in the record.

**New findings (neither blocks DG5):**
- **F-DG5-144 (Medium, not mandatory, REQ-S15-009):** the Diagnose screen scrolls sideways at page level at 390 px (433 px en, 394 px ar) and with 200 % text. The workstream cards' grid grows to the widest card's content. This CSS hasn't changed since DG2, so it's not a regression, and the requirement's final gate is DG6. It should be fixed before DG6.
- **F-DG5-145 (Low, not mandatory, REQ-S16-001):** the module-boundary unit test timed out at its 30 s budget in 4 of 6 full Node 22 runs under load (30–67 s). Run alone it takes 12.7 s. This is test reliability only, like the earlier F-DG2-143.

I saw only the commit titles of the other reviewers' round-3 records, never their contents. The disposable clone has been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-3/`:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.verifications.json
- qa-verifier.findings.json
- qa-verifier.md

Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-3/`, and my probe tests are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/tests/round-3/`.
